prompt: Write SeatCounter, a bounded reservation counter whose invariant 0 <= reserved <= capacity holds only because the fields are private. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Marking capacity and reserved private means no outside code can assign them, so every change has to pass through reserve or release, and those two methods are the only place the rule 0 <= reserved <= capacity has to be enforced. A method that refuses a bad request must return before it touches any field, otherwise the object is left half-updated. Making capacity final states that it is fixed for the object's whole life.
hints: Declare the fields as private (and capacity as final) so only the methods in this class can change them.
Do the validation first: return false before modifying anything, so a rejected call leaves the object exactly as it was.
reserve fails when n <= 0 or when reserved + n > capacity; release fails when n <= 0 or n > reserved.
